## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat` — New feature
- [ ] `fix` — Bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — Documentation
- [ ] `refactor` — Refactor (no feature/fix)
- [ ] `test` — Tests only
- [ ] `chore` — CI, build, deps

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the project's code standards
- [ ] I have added tests that cover my changes
- [ ] All existing tests pass (`pytest tests/`)
- [ ] Linting passes (`ruff check . && mypy .`)
- [ ] No secrets or credentials are committed
- [ ] Documentation updated if necessary
- [ ] `docs/api-design.md` updated for new endpoints
